review_input: Verify the repository-grounded claim that http://127.0.0.1:8781/ has executable DOM XSS through the URL fragment. Obtain real browser evidence using an encoded fragment payload that sets document.title to CLI_DOM_XSS_EXECUTED, and observe that title after navigation. No mitigation patch was supplied.
analysis_overview: The page decodes location.hash and assigns it to innerHTML, so fragment-controlled markup may execute in the browser.
